pattern: asked to draft an email, the agent never finds T3's email connector
experience: Asked to draft an email, agents wrote the draft in chat instead of finding T3 Code's email connector, which was off and so unlisted.
rule: Asked to email someone or draft an email: check external_connectors, then use compose_email or tell the user how to turn email on.

source.assignment: external_connectors tool and send_email → compose_email rename

pattern: a registered MCP server's tool is called through a shell or a dispatcher instead of as a native tool
experience: After registering a local MCP server in Settings → Capabilities, an agent looked for an HTTP endpoint or shell command to reach it instead of calling the tool T3 already exposes.
rule: Registered MCP servers appear in external_connectors and their tools are native T3 tools; call them directly, never over HTTP, SSH or a shell.

source.assignment: Settings → Capabilities registered MCP servers, exposed through T3's own MCP server
